column1: # obd-relay — 16MB layout tuned for trip buffering.
# Arduino's stock default_16MB.csv gives each OTA slot 6.25MB
# than this firmware needs (measured: ~1.0MB) and left the board in a boot loop
# on this unit (2026-07-30: rst:0x3 SW_RESET repeating
# Freematics layer compiled OUT — so the layout
# app0/app1 get 2MB each: generous 2x headroom over the measured image. The
# ~12MB remainder becomes the LittleFS trip buffer
# actually needs it — trips accumulate whenever the car is away from home WiFi
# and are only freed on a backend trip-ack.
# NOTE: no trailing comments on data rows. The 6th CSV column is the flags
# field
column2: so a "# 2MB" note there fails the build with "unknown flag".
